media.title: MGM Years — document gallery
media.description: Document gallery for Kaper's MGM/Hollywood years. Includes Polish and American press coverage, studio-era publicity, reviews, and contextual images from 1934–1938. SRC0041 is represented here as a Nasz Przegląd Ilustrowany 1934 clipped press image showing Kaper, not as a separate standalone Media record within this gallery.

media.title: Evening Star, 4 July 1937 — Kahn, Kaper and Jurmann song assignment
media.description: Gossip note 'Song Assignment' in the Evening Star (Washington, D.C.), 4 July 1937: Gus Kahn, Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann — who wrote the song hits for A Day at the Races and San Francisco — assigned to write the tunes for MGM's 'The Ugly Duckling', which was released as Everybody Sing (1938). Source: SRC0050 / Library of Congress, Chronicling America.
media.altText: Newspaper clipping from Evening Star, 4 July 1937.
